content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"gap","note":"The decision rules on numbered claims (1-11, claims 9 and 10, event 7) that the summary never defines, and its claim 5 finding that Complainant raised no concerns until May 14, 2021 cannot be squared with her account of reporting the October 24, 2020 comments to Witness 2, so the path from evidence to conclusion cannot be fully traced."},"rc2":{"status":"review","note":"Complainant's allegations and the alcohol-policy witness accounts carry ROI page cites (e.g., ROI at 147, 248-9), but key decision characterizations ('management officials testified,' the Medical Provider testimony, 'the record showed') have no cited source, and the alcohol-policy witnesses are unnamed."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"Key dates are given (October 24, 2020; December 3, 2020; May 5-6, 2021; May 13-14, 2021), but the SOT on May 13 is described as following the May 14 reprimand, and the timing of her prior EEO activity and of the complaint filing is not identified."},"rc4":{"status":"review","note":"The legal framework is documented (prima facie case, pretext, harassment severity) and one rebuttal argument (the Manager's drinking) is addressed, but the deciding official and the 'responsible management official' are not identified, and Witness 1's corroboration and the report to Witness 2 are not shown to have been considered."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"Undefined claim numbering, an unexplained medical-provider event, uncited testimony, and an unaddressed conflict between the record and the claim 5 finding mean an independent reviewer would need the full ROI to judge whether the conclusion is supported."}}}
